senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; חָבָא)hiding place in times of war &c.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Yevamot 12:4">Tosef. Yeb. XII, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Yevamot 99a:2">Yeb. 99ᵃ</cite> <he>ילדו … במ׳</he> gave birth to two children (each to one child) in a hiding place (so that the motherhood of each child could not be ascertained).
